name: campussync
description: CampusSync - University Campus Management & Student Experience Platform

scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.start: npm --prefix server run prisma:deploy && (npm --prefix server run seed:accounts || echo "[start] account seed skipped") && node server/dist/index.js
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.db:seed: npm --prefix server run seed:accounts && npm --prefix server run seed:attendance

author: CampusSync Team
